maggie: Heads-up — PR #22001 is green locally but CI is queued behind a long mac-e2e job. Would prefer to land in the 22:00 UTC rebase window to avoid the nightly deploy freeze. Any chance of eyes + quick canary?

kevin: On it. I'll kick a rerun for the mac matrix. ping @ryan in case a rebase helps.

ci-bot: CI queue position: 42. Estimated start: ~45m. mac-e2e currently running 3 jobs.

ryan: If CI still queued in 30m I can do a small rebase to drop a flaky test. Should be <5m. Need review approval though.

tasha: I can review now, but I have one nit. Leaving inline comment.

maggie: thanks @tasha — it's tiny, can fix in PR. Can someone give approve after fix? we want to avoid waiting for next day's window.

kevin: approve after patch. @maggie add a short note in PR summary about the freeze window.

maggie: done. also running `./scripts/smoke.sh` in a container. output: PASS — small snippet:
```
All checks passed: 12 tests
No regressions
```

kevin: kicking CI rerun: `/ci retry 22001`

ci-bot: Build queued; new position 10. ETA ~12m.

ryan: if position > 20 still, I'll rebase in 10m.

maggie: agree. @kevin can you ping release ops if we miss the window so they can hold the freeze? don't want surprise deploy.

kevin: will do. also logging this in the merge board.

deploy-bot: Heads-up — nightly deploy freeze scheduled from 23:00-02:00 UTC.

tasha: approved — LGTM after minor fix. leaving approve once CI passes.

maggie: thanks all. will land after CI + canary. marking thread resolved.
